About Anker in Kenya

Batteriq is an authorised Anker dealer in Kenya. We stock 86 Anker products — power banks, wall and car chargers, USB-C hubs and cables — from KES 100 to KES 216,340. Every unit is genuine and covered by a 24-month warranty.
